export_smplx_gltf: export a SMPL-X body model from Blender as a GLB file for URDF skinning
export_smplx_urdf: export a humanoid armature from Blender as a URDF file with joint and link definitions
set_smplx_texture: set a texture on the SMPL-X humanoid mesh using a file path or built-in texture name
setup_smplx_bones: setup mass and inertia properties on Blender bones for URDF export
generate_smplx_humanoid: generate SMPL-X humanoid avatars with random or specified gender, betas, and textures via Blender CLI
